newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - JP Morgan ups PetroFina to "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - JP Morgan ups PetroFina to "buy".

text.p: Belgian oil group PetroFina was upgraded to "buy" from "market performer" at JP Morgan, the investment bank said on Wednesday.
JP Morgan analysts expected PetroFina to report a "significant upside surprise" in its first-half results that are set to be released on Thursday.
A 12-month price target was set at BF 16,000. The stock was trading at 15,050 by 1140 GMT.
Consensus earnings estimates are at least 20 percent too low and the investment bank raised its own earnings per share estimates to BF 972, JP Morgan said.

PetroFina has the greatest leverage to the strong refining and marketing margins seen in the U.S. and Europe this year, JP Morgan said. The group will also benefit from its petrochemical margins in those two markets into the third quarter, it said.
The strength of sterling further enhances PetroFina's margins in the U.K. when translated into Belgian Francs, it said.

"Given our expectation of a significant upside surprise in PetroFina's first-half results, continued good macro conditions in the second half and positive newsflow, we believe that its stock price should continue its excellent performance of the last few weeks, though perhaps at a lesser pace," the investment bank said.
